market_definition: The rigid polyurethane foam market comprises closed-cell, highly cross-linked polyurethane foams offering high thermal insulation and structural strength in panel, block and pour-in-place forms. It measures sales of PUR rigid foam products, excluding PIR, spray and canned grades. BY PRODUCT FORM: Boardstock / Laminated Panels, Slabstock Blocks, Pour-in-Place, Pipe & Vessel Insulation Shells. BY BLOWING AGENT: Pentane, HFO / HFC, Water-Blown, Other. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Residential Buildings, Commercial & Industrial Buildings, Cold Storage & Refrigeration, Pipes, Tanks & Industrial Insulation, Transportation & Infrastructure, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Polyisocyanurate (PIR) foam; spray and canned polyurethane foam; semi-rigid and flexible polyurethane foams; XPS and EPS insulation. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. PRODUCT SCOPE (required): "polyurethane" AND ("MDI" OR "TDI" OR "polyol" OR "isocyanate" OR "foam" OR "elastomer") AND ("distributor" OR "wholesaler"). Qualifying: MDI/TDI isocyanates, polyols, PU systems and prepolymers, flexible/rigid PU foam, PU elastomers, adhesives, sealants, coatings, TPU resins. EXCLUDE general chemical distributors with no named PU line, furniture/mattress retailers, and PU machinery suppliers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
